raw_check.ten_rows_read: layer 0 q,k,v,o,gate,up,down; 14 v; 21 o; 31 down (code31>math31, think_sft>math31, math30>math31 shares). All shares positive and finite, no duplicated matrices, shapes 4096x4096 (attention) and 11008x4096 / 4096x11008 (MLP). The ratio is below 1 because Code 3.1's input-side capture (cap_right) is raised far more than its output side in v, o, gate, up, down (e.g. layer 0 v: left 0.025, right 0.251), while Think-SFT's two sides are both low and closer to each other (layer 0 v: 0.008, 0.032). Math 3.0 shows the same input-side excess as Code 3.1 (layer 0 v: 0.018, 0.315), so this is a shared RL-Zero pattern, not a Code-specific one. Only q and k medians are near 1 (0.94, 1.07). Nothing in the rows suggests the statistic measures something other than its name.
